contributions.headingText: Rare tumours in the broad and round ligaments include those proposed to be of Wolffian duct or supernumerary ovary origins, such as fibroma with heterotopic bone formation {8349152}, fibroma with minor sex cord elements {28351194}, and fibrosarcoma {25760903}. Miscellaneous benign mesenchymal tumours include lipoleiomyoma {16810060; 20379451; 19716558}, solitary fibrous tumour {17493768; 30278559}, and angiomyofibroblastoma {28800578}. Sarcomas include endometrial stromal sarcoma {843483; 17235569}, alveolar soft part sarcoma {8598329}, malignant fibrous histiocytoma {8088614}, myxoid liposarcoma {11576262}, Ewing sarcoma {16175085}, malignant perivascular epithelioid cell tumour (PEComa) {15361222}, and low-grade fibromyxoid sarcoma {27185563}. Several cases of rhabdomyosarcoma, including a case with an underlying DICER1 mutation, have also been reported {4016676; 7472949; 25006297; 28524158}.
